data.name: Rahul
data.gender_notes: Rahul is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Efficient; capable; (also) the son of Buddha
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root rah, 'to be able, to be efficient' — 'able, capable'. Its root is Sanskrit rah (रह्). Rahula, the son of the Buddha. Rahul is a Sanskrit name meaning “Efficient; capable; (also) the son of Buddha”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rahul expresses “Efficient; capable; (also) the son of Buddha”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root rah, 'to be able, to be efficient' — 'able, capable'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahul total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
